# PALSEC AGCY

> Strategic design studio based in Costa Brava, Spain, serving Girona and teams worldwide. PALSEC AGCY works across brand strategy, branding and visual identity, web design, digital products, motion graphics, and creative direction.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-27

## Studio

PALSEC AGCY was founded in 2025. The studio's public team includes Arnau Piñol Olabegoya and Guillem Ferrando Codina. Project pages describe work and design decisions visible in the published portfolio; the site does not claim unverified performance results or client metrics.

## Core services

- [Brand strategy](https://www.palsec.agency/en/services/brand-strategy): positioning, proposition, naming, tone of voice, and an activation roadmap.
- [Branding and visual identity](https://www.palsec.agency/en/services/branding-visual-identity): identity systems, typography, color, graphic language, applications, and usage criteria.
- [Web design and digital products](https://www.palsec.agency/en/services/web-design-digital-products): information architecture, UX/UI, prototypes, responsive interfaces, and component systems.

## Selected work

- [VIRA](https://www.palsec.agency/en/project/vira): mobile UX/UI, brand identity, visual system, and design language for an app addressing challenges faced by teenagers with ADHD.
- [ARKUOS](https://www.palsec.agency/en/project/arkuos): brand application, design system, communication pieces, and visual language for a socio-educational creative environment.
- [GALEÓN](https://www.palsec.agency/en/project/galeon): product design, UX/UI, visual system, and interactive content for exploring history and the Royal Collections.
- [EL XIRINGUITO](https://www.palsec.agency/en/project/el-xiringuito): identity, menu system, print, signage, and digital assets for a coastal restaurant concept.
- [ENTEZA](https://www.palsec.agency/en/project/enteza): brand system, catalog structure, digital design, and product presentation for event furniture and tableware rental.
- [GENT GRAN DE CALONGE I SANT ANTONI](https://www.palsec.agency/en/project/gent-gran-de-calonge-i-sant-antoni): accessible public-sector identity and communication system for activities for older adults.
- [LOGOTECA](https://www.palsec.agency/en/project/logoteca): a curated collection of logo design work exploring typography, symbol, proportion, and contrast.

## Location and availability

PALSEC AGCY is based in Costa Brava and is available for work worldwide. The website does not publish a visitor address or claim a public storefront.
